engines.engine_xml:
<rocket_engine name="meteor atmosphere-fed engineering sustainer">
    <isp>
        <function>
            <quotient>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/gross-thrust-n</property>
                <max>
                    <value>9.9999999999999998e-13</value>
                    <product>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
                        <value>9.8066499999999994</value>
                    </product>
                </max>
            </quotient>
        </function>
    </isp>
    <propflowmax unit="LBS/SEC">0.66138678655463268</propflowmax>
    <mixtureratio>0</mixtureratio>
    <minthrottle>0.000001</minthrottle>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-enthalpy-w</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-momentum-x-n</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-momentum-y-n</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-momentum-z-n</property>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/fuel-kg-s" type="pre">
        <product>
            <property>propulsion/engine[1]/fuel-flow-rate-pps</property>
            <value>0.45359237000000002</value>
        </product>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/burned-fuel-kg-s" type="pre">
        <min>
            <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
            <product>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                <value>0.080000000000000002</value>
            </product>
        </min>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/total-temperature-k" type="pre">
        <quotient>
            <sum>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-enthalpy-w</property>
                <product>
                    <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/burned-fuel-kg-s</property>
                    <value>36000000</value>
                </product>
            </sum>
            <max>
                <value>9.9999999999999998e-13</value>
                <product>
                    <sum>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
                    </sum>
                    <value>1150</value>
                </product>
            </max>
        </quotient>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/pressure-ratio" type="pre">
        <max>
            <value>1</value>
            <product>
                <value>0.84999999999999998</value>
                <pow>
                    <quotient>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-enthalpy-w</property>
                        <max>
                            <value>9.9999999999999998e-13</value>
                            <product>
                                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                                <value>558.05555555555554</value>
                                <property>atmosphere/T-R</property>
                            </product>
                        </max>
                    </quotient>
                    <value>3.5</value>
                </pow>
            </product>
        </max>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/exit-speed-m-s" type="pre">
        <sqrt>
            <max>
                <value>0</value>
                <product>
                    <value>2300</value>
                    <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/total-temperature-k</property>
                    <difference>
                        <value>1</value>
                        <pow>
                            <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/pressure-ratio</property>
                            <value>-0.24812030075187974</value>
                        </pow>
                    </difference>
                </product>
            </max>
        </sqrt>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/gross-thrust-n" type="pre">
        <product>
            <sum>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
            </sum>
            <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/exit-speed-m-s</property>
        </product>
    </function>
</rocket_engine>

descriptor.note: PN uses measured radial speed and LOS history. Launch estimates remain separate inertial-midcourse inputs. The admitted receive fit uses WorldWeaponLinks finite modeled transport of accepted platform fusion before guidance can consume an update. This receive-only configuration does not acquire return telemetry.
descriptor.validity: Reduced-order game simulation; equipment performance and damage effectiveness unvalidated.

navigation_gain.note: Retained engineering navigation ratio; no scene-fit or manufacturer calibration.

cue_deg.note: Retained engineering acquisition association cone.

activation_ratio.note: Retained generic activation range / seeker acquisition range.

loft_deg.note: Retained generic supported-midcourse loft angle.

loft_acceleration_g.note: Retained generic loft acceleration multiplier.

max_g.note: Retained generic guidance demand limit; native fin/aerodynamic authority can realize less.

life_s.note: Retained generic guidance/battery execution lifetime assumption.

inertial_midcourse.note: Transcribed existing simulator assumption unchanged. Uncertainty is unquantified; zero does not claim measurement accuracy.

launcher_updates.note: Transcribed existing simulator assumption unchanged. Uncertainty is unquantified; zero does not claim measurement accuracy.

equations: a_PN=N*V_scale*(LOS_dot projected perpendicular own velocity); gravity compensation added before total maxG clipping
V_scale=positive measured closing when available; otherwise own speed. Range/closing availability is a sensor capability, not inferred target truth
F_required=m*a; LOSrate_saturation≈g0*sqrt(maxG^2-1)/(N*V_scale) for orthogonal gravity and steering

equations: F_eff=F_angle-F_control*M_angle/M_control; solve force/path and moment trim together at actual CG
x=[angle,body_rate,actual_virtual_surface]; A=[[F_angle/(mV),sign,F_control/(mV)],[M_angle/J,M_rate/J,M_control/J],[0,0,-1/tau]]
cascade K=[(J*sign/(Tr*Ti)+M_angle)/M_control,(J/Tr+M_rate)/M_control,0]; actuator-aware K instead assigns eig(A-BK)=[-1/tau,-1/Tr,-1/Ti]
operating-point controller minimizes ||J^-1*(M_pred(u)-M_target)||^2 under finite channel/fin lag, rate, stops and current nonlinear fin curves; local search is not global optimality
